name: cowork-userconfig2-probe
description: Re-probe of userConfig against the post-2.1.207 spec: shell-form hooks now REJECT ${user_config.*} while exec form substitutes it, values reach hooks as CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_<KEY>, and non-sensitive values substitute in skill/agent content. Declares every documented option field (type string/number/boolean, required, sensitive, default, multiple, min/max) so the input UI itself can be inspected on Claude Desktop Code vs Cowork.

opt_secret.title: Optional secret
opt_secret.description: sensitive optional (dummy value only). Enter: OPTSECRET-VAL

req_secret.title: Required secret
req_secret.description: sensitive required (dummy value only). Enter: REQSECRET-VAL

def_plain.title: Defaulted plain
def_plain.description: LEAVE THIS EMPTY - tests whether the manifest default is applied at runtime

multi_opt.title: Multiple strings
multi_opt.description: string with multiple:true. Enter two entries: M1 and M2
